identity_note: Matched Metropolis Technologies (metropolis.io), the AI computer-vision parking platform and operator that took SP Plus private; sector (parking), stage (growth / Series D) and US HQ all match the batch entry. Not to be confused with Metropolis Healthcare (India) or other 'Metropolis' brands.

profile.name: Metropolis Technologies
profile.description: AI computer-vision platform that lets drivers enter and leave parking facilities without tickets or kiosks, run across a network it also operates (including SP+) for property owners, airports, hospitals and municipalities.
profile.location: Santa Monica, CA (HQ); offices in Nashville, New York, Chicago and Seattle; engineering also in Bengaluru and Stockport (AeroParker)
profile.founder: Alex Israel (Co-Founder & CEO); co-founders Travis Kell, Peter Fisher, Courtney Fukuda
profile.funding_detail: Nov 2025: $1.6B package at ~$5B valuation = $500M Series D led by a LionTree-managed fund (with BDT & MSD credit funds, DFJ, Eldridge, Slow Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Tekne, Vista) + $1.1B Term Loan B arranged by JPMorgan. Prior: ~$1.7-1.8B debt+equity (2023, led by Eldridge and 3L) to fund the SP+ take-private. Crunchbase puts total debt+equity raised since 2017 at ~$3.5B.
profile.headcount: Sources disagree: Revelio Labs ~10,224 (Dec 2025); Wikipedia 20,000+ (2024, incl. SP+ field staff); data vendors as low as ~1,800 (likely corporate only). LinkedIn's own figure not read.
profile.past_completed_deals: Oosto (formerly AnyVision, Israeli computer-vision firm) - ~$125M mostly-stock deal announced Jan 2025; SP Plus Corporation - ~$1.5B take-private, announced Oct 2023, completed 2024; Premier Parking (Nashville) - 2022.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Sales (9 Director, Business Development roles plus Associate Account Executives), Growth, Engineering/Applied AI, Finance, Legal, People, Product (84 open corporate roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Proven acquirer · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: Bought SP+, Premier Parking and Oosto, then raised $1.6B in Nov 2025; no deal announced in 2026 and no corp-dev/M&A role on the live board, so the CEO is the route in.
